In a Quarto website or book, `[the methods](methods.qmd)` resolves because the reader is on the site and the other page is next to it.
Render the same document to PDF, Word, Typst, or a slide deck, and the file travels on its own: the target is not there, and the link is dead.

`portable-links` rewrites those links for the formats that leave the site behind.
A relative cross-page link becomes an absolute one built from the project's `site-url`, so it points at the published page instead of a file that is not there.

## Installation

```bash
quarto add {{< var extension.reference >}}
```

This will install the extension under the `_extensions` subdirectory.
If you are using version control, you will want to check in this directory.

Or install it from your editor with [Quarto Wizard](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-wizard):

::: {.btn-group role="group" aria-label="Quarto Wizard installer options"}

## Quick start

The filter needs the project's `site-url`, which belongs in the project configuration rather than a document:

```yaml
website:
  site-url: "https://example.com/my-site"
```

Enable the filter:

```yaml
filters:
  - portable-links
```

Then write links exactly as you would for the website:

```markdown
See the [methods page](methods.qmd) and [the appendix](appendix.html#notes).
```

In HTML nothing changes.
In a PDF, a Word file, or a deck, those become `https://example.com/my-site/methods.html` and `https://example.com/my-site/appendix.html#notes`.

## Seeing it work

This site is HTML, so the filter deliberately leaves its pages alone.
The [Typst preview](preview.pdf) is the same site rendered to a format that does leave it behind, and its links point back here.

See the [Reference](reference.qmd) for the rewriting rules, and the [Examples](examples.qmd) for each of them.

## Where it works

| Rewritten | Left alone |
| --- | --- |
| PDF, LaTeX, Typst, Word, PowerPoint, and every other non-HTML format. | Plain HTML, format extensions built on `html`, and `epub`. |
| The HTML slide formats: `revealjs`, `slidy`, `s5`, `dzslides`, `slideous`. | |

: Which formats the filter touches. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[50,50]"}

A slide deck is self-contained even though it is HTML, so cross-page links do not resolve in it and it is rewritten too.
